title: Architect's Palette Withered Bone Extra
description: Extra Compatibility & Fix for Architects Palette's Withered Bone
body:
# Withered Bone Extra
## Architect's Palette Addon Datapack

### Why this pack exists:

This pack adds withered bone into wither-related mobs loot tables, like naga from Better Nether, originally was made for personal uses

### Primary Features:

Fixed/Removed bone drops from Wither Skeleton (vanilla)

Compatibility for Withered Bone for other mods

**Current mobs compat:**
- Naga (Better Nether)
- Baby Wither Skeleton (Tiny Skeleton)

### Additional Features:

Naga now drops wither skeleton skull when killed by Charged Creeper
